name: hidden-disabled
note: Hidden and disabled controls (corpus/form-controls): input[type=hidden] stays display:none with a zero rect like Chrome, and the disabled look — a disabled text input (border-color rgba(118,118,118,0.3), background rgba(239,239,239,0.3), color rgb(84,84,84)), a disabled select (border washed, color rgb(128,128,128), popup fill washed over the theme white) and a disabled button (fill rgb(238,238,238), washed frame and label) — computed styles, rects and paint against Chrome.
